name: frontend-motion-kit
description: Personal design, typography and motion playbook for every front-end project. Use this skill whenever the user builds, scaffolds or restyles any website or UI (landing pages, club or community sites, portfolios, event pages, dashboards, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte or plain HTML/CSS), and whenever they mention animation, transitions, page transitions, scroll effects, hover effects, custom cursors, loaders, Google Fonts, typography, hero sections, or "make it look better", even if they do not ask for animation explicitly. Provides a dark-first design baseline, a Google Fonts pairing and loading guide, a section blueprint for organisation sites, and tested animation recipes (GSAP, Lenis, CSS, View Transitions) distilled from ten leading animated websites.

name: headline-motion-kit
description: Motion recipes for giant hero headlines and page transitions, built from the Studio UNLMTD home page headline "The limits are now opportunities" (its long word split over two lines as OPPOR-TUNITIES). Use this skill whenever a landing page needs an oversized headline that reveals line by line, a long word broken across lines with letter-by-letter motion, a word that gets crossed out and replaced to tell a before-and-after story, hero text that drifts away on scroll, a full-screen wipe between pages, or a "tell us your limit" style interaction. Dependency-free (Web Animations API), accessible, reduced-motion safe. Pairs with frontend-motion-kit, immersive-media-kit and registration-landing-kit.

name: immersive-media-kit
description: Playbook for image-led, sound-enabled front-end pages. Use this skill whenever a front-end task involves images that react to the user (click an image then scroll or drag to turn it around, 360 or turntable viewers, 3D ring galleries, lightboxes), text placed on top of images (hero overlays, captions, scrims, blend modes), an opt-in sound feature (ambient loop, sound on/off toggle, hover sounds), a footer with a giant full-width wordmark and stacked lines, an animated contact or address page with a map, horizontal drag sections, preloader counters, or a cookie/analytics consent panel. Pairs with frontend-motion-kit; use both for full pages.

name: registration-landing-kit
description: Playbook and ready-to-copy code for landing pages of registration, booking and enquiry systems. Use this skill whenever the user is building or restyling a landing page, sign-up page, event or course registration page, appointment or booking page, enquiry or contact page, or any page with a registration form, date and time slot picker, address or location block, "book a call" flow, info bar, full-screen menu, or contact cards. Provides a page blueprint, an accessible registration form module, a booking slot picker with calendar-file export, an address block with maps and copy buttons, a full-screen menu, and a stylesheet. Pairs with frontend-motion-kit (type, motion) and immersive-media-kit (images, footer, sound).
